card.name: Letter-spaced or all-caps label text
card.fires_on: Pieces of words in all-caps warnings or letter-spaced headings, such as the end of a split-up word or a small word in a capitalised sentence. It fires mid-word, not on ordinary lowercase prose.

modes.label: Letter-spaced headings
modes.description: Parts of headings broken into separate letters, such as Maintenance Therapy or Benzodiazepines.
modes.example: M ain t en<<ance>> T he r ap y : The recommended

modes.label: All-caps warning sentences
modes.description: Small linking words or word parts inside capitalised boxed warnings.
modes.example: ATORVASTATIN SHOULD BE ADMINISTERED TO WOMEN<< OF>> CHILDBEARING AGE ONLY WHEN

card.plain: It lights up on oddly formatted text, like spaced-out letters or all-capital warnings, partway through a word or phrase.
